checks.name: Every entity name is in the pinned prototypes and in the allowed set
Unique entity IDs
Blueprint version is 2.1.25
No modules, no quality, no tiles, no custom inserter reach
Rotated collision boxes do not overlap
Footprint: 34 wide; the mall part and the fuel part are stacked rectangles with no row between them
Machines: 5 foundries, 9 assembling machines 3, 3 oil refineries, 5 chemical plants, 1 electric furnace
Every fixed recipe is pinned and can be crafted in its machine
Every switching and shadow machine takes its recipe from the circuit network and has no fixed recipe
Every rule selects a pinned recipe its machine can craft
Nothing of the assembling machine 3 line or the platform kit is left
The ring is one directed unbranched closed loop of red belt
No belt outside the ring points into the ring
Exactly one ring belt reads the whole ring (hold); every other ring belt only carries the wire
Every arm picks up and drops where its role says; no arm of the fuel section touches the ring
Every arm has its hand size pinned (fast 1, bulk 2)
Every ring-feeding arm is gated on its item below the ring limit
Chest OUT-1: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-2: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-3: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Chest OUT-4: its arm takes from the ring and drops into its chest
Every pipe, underground pipe, tank and pump belongs to exactly one declared fluid
No pipe of one fluid connects to a pipe of another
Every underground pipe has exactly one partner within ten tiles
The lava pipes: one network
The molten-copper pipes: two single pipes, both between the two copper foundries
The molten-iron pipes: one network
The water pipes: one network
The lubricant pipes: one network
The sulfuric-acid pipes: one network
The heavy-oil pipes: one network
The light-oil pipes: one network
Only the one cracker the rocket fuel supply mirrors is mirrored
No machine has two ports of one kind on pipes of different fluids (the crackers apart: two fluids, two boxes, fixed recipe)
Mall part: every machine fluid port touches the fluid it is meant to (and nothing else touches a port)
The water pump stands directly between the water pipe and the casting foundry port it feeds (nothing flows back through it)
Fuel section: every port a recipe uses has a pipe of its fluid, and no pipe opening faces an unused port (the rocket fuel supply's measured tables)
The only pipes that join the mall part and the fuel section carry water
No connector belongs to two circuit nets
Every circuit wire joins two members of the same net and is within reach
Every circuit net is connected
Rule deciders read stock on red (loose stock, or the ring and the casting foundry) and the control net on green
Fuel section: no machine is on a circuit wire; its chest and its four output arms read the cap, nothing else
Every powered entity stands in a substation supply area
Power is five substations in one copper chain, nothing else
Every listed product has a rule at its group level; rocket fuel has none
Every level weight sits in its level band
Each switching machine has a parking recipe: an idle rule (the casting foundry) or a park decider (U1, U2)
The recipe wire of U1 and U2 is never without a recipe: "parked" is also raised on the tick a craft ends with the pick to park
The caps combinator holds every cap, rocket fuel included
Every stock has exactly one chest
Every chest list names exactly its declared products
Every output chest is a passive provider chest; the only other chest is the belt foundry's buffer
Belt foundry buffer: its only output arm drops into the chest, the chest arm drops on the ring, every item the foundry can hold has a limit, and the limits fit the inner lane
Every entrance, the stone exit, the power connection, the caps combinator and every chest has a display panel
Every entrance panel carries its per-minute figure
Every entrance and the stone exit lies on the edge of the footprint with its outside tile free
No display panel on the top row (it would reach over the edge)
The ring limits of each lane, all reached at once, fit that lane
The technology closure includes the foundry, calcite processing (coal liquefaction), rocket fuel and the selector combinator
